```{r setup, include=FALSE}
valeur = function(x, defaut = "Non renseigne") {
  if (!length(x) || is.na(x[[1]]) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x[[1]]))))
    return(defaut)
  as.character(x[[1]])
}
texte = function(x) {
  x = valeur(x, "")
  x = gsub("\r\n?", "\n", x)
  x = gsub("\\\\par\\b", "\n", x, perl = TRUE)
  if (grepl("<[^>]+>|&[A-Za-z#0-9]+;", x)) {
    x = gsub("(?i)<br\\s*/?>|</(p|div|li)>", "\n", x, perl = TRUE)
    x = tryCatch(xml2::xml_text(xml2::read_html(paste0("<div>", x, "</div>"))),
                 error = function(e) gsub("<[^>]+>", "", x))
  }
  lignes = strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lignes = trimws(lignes)
  lignes = lignes[nzchar(lignes)]
  for (symbole in c("\\", "`", "*", "_", "{", "}", "[", "]", "<", ">", "#", "!", "|"))
    lignes = gsub(symbole, paste0("\\", symbole), lignes, fixed = TRUE)
  paste(lignes, collapse = "\n\n")
}
``` 

```{r entete, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("\\gdef\\senateurstitre{", params$titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurssoustitre{", params$sous_titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurslogo{\\raisebox{-8pt}{\\includegraphics[height=0.78cm]{\\detokenize{",
    params$logo, "}}}}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\pagestyle{senateurs}\n")
```

```{r dossier, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
d = params$donnees$dossier[1, ]
docs = params$donnees$documents
amds = params$donnees$amendements
cat("**Identifiant officiel :** ", texte(d$uid), "  \n",
    "**Sujet :** ", texte(d$titre), "  \n",
    "**Procedure :** ", texte(d$procedure), "  \n",
    "**Legislature :** ", texte(d$legislature), "\n\n",
    "## Documents officiellement rattaches\n\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(docs)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(docs))) {
    doc = docs[i, ]
    titre = texte(doc$titre)
    if (!nzchar(titre)) titre = "Titre non renseigne"
    date = "Date non renseignee"
    for (champ in c("date_depot", "date_publication", "date_creation")) {
      x = valeur(doc[[champ]], "")
      if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}", x)) {
        libelle = c(date_depot = "Depot", date_publication = "Publication",
                    date_creation = "Creation")[[champ]]
        date = paste(libelle, substr(x, 1, 10), sep = " : ")
        break
      }
    }
    cat("\n\n### ", i, ". ", titre, "\n\n",
        "**Reference :** ", texte(doc$document_uid), "  \n",
        "**Date :** ", date, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
} else cat("Aucun document rattache dans la base locale.\n\n")
cat("\n\n## Amendements relies par reference de texte\n\n",
    "**Total :** ", nrow(amds), " amendement(s).\n\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(amds)) {
  sorts = as.character(amds$sort)
  sorts[is.na(sorts) | !nzchar(trimws(sorts)) | grepl('"@xsi:nil"\\s*:\\s*"true"', sorts)] = "Non renseigne"
  comptes = sort(table(sorts), decreasing = TRUE)
  recap = data.frame(Sort = names(comptes), Nombre = as.integer(comptes))
  cat(paste(knitr::kable(recap, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
} else cat("Aucun amendement relie par reference de texte dans la base locale.\n")
```
